concept_uz: Jasur hayotidagi eng muhim suhbatga erta keladi — lekin bir koʻchadagi nomi deyarli bir xil ikki binodan notoʻgʻrisiga kirib qoladi. Olti daqiqada yugurib boradi, suhbat barbod boʻladi. Burilish: ikki kundan keyin oʻsha «notoʻgʻri» binodagi kichik studiyadan qoʻngʻiroq — va u yerda besh yildan beri ishlaydi.

facts.claim: Hikoyachi hayotidagi eng muhim suhbatga yigirma daqiqa erta kelgan
Oʻn toʻrtinchi qavatdagi qabul xodimi bu binoda bunday kompaniya yoʻqligini aytgan
Bir koʻchada, uch koʻcha (three blocks) narida deyarli bir xil nomli ikkita bino boʻlgan
Xatoni anglaganda toʻgʻri binoga yetish uchun roppa-rosa olti daqiqa qolgan, u butun yoʻlni yugurgan
Suhbat falokat boʻlgan: oddiy savollarda duduqlangan, kechikkani uchun uzr soʻrashdan toʻxtay olmagan

Ikki kundan keyin notoʻgʻri binoning oʻn toʻrtinchi qavatidagi kichik dizayn studiyasidan qoʻngʻiroq boʻlgan; qabul xodimi uni menejerga aytgan, menejer aynan shunday tajribali odam qidirayotgan, suhbat-imtihonsiz gaplashishga chaqirgan
Besh yildan keyin ham u oʻsha studiyada ishlaydi; adashib, aynan kerakli joyga kelgan

style_line: Cinematic photoreal drama, bright modern city morning, glass towers, clean cool blue and warm wood tones, soft film grain, 35mm look, gentle hopeful mood with light comedy. No text, no letters, no logos, no signage, no watermark.

refs.prompt: Vertical 9:16 wide street-level shot of a busy downtown avenue on a sunny morning: two tall, nearly identical blue-glass office towers stand on the same side of the street, about three blocks apart, the far one smaller in the distance; wide sidewalks, young trees, people walking to work. Blank facades, no signs.

Vertical 9:16 full-body portrait of an Uzbek young man about twenty-five, neat short dark hair, clean-shaven, earnest slightly nervous face, a NAVY SUIT a little too big for him, a white shirt and a BRIGHT RED TIE, holding a BROWN LEATHER FOLDER to his chest, standing on a city sidewalk in morning light.

Vertical 9:16 waist-up portrait of an Uzbek woman about thirty, kind attentive face, dark hair in a low bun, a TEAL BLAZER, a YELLOW PENCIL tucked behind her right ear, standing behind a white reception desk in a bright glass office lobby, a potted plant beside her.

Combine the attached images into one vertical 9:16 shot in the bright fourteenth-floor glass lobby: the young man in the navy suit and red tie stands at the reception desk holding out his phone, smiling hopefully; the receptionist in the teal blazer with the yellow pencil looks at the phone with a puzzled, apologetic frown. Same faces, morning light.

Change the scene: the young man in the navy suit runs flat out along the sunny sidewalk toward the farther glass tower, red tie flying over his shoulder, brown folder clamped under his arm, people stepping aside. Low tracking angle, motion blur on the background. Same face, 9:16.

Change the scene: a cold grey meeting room with a long table; the young man in the navy suit and red tie sits alone on one side, out of breath, hair messy, sweat on his forehead, shirt clinging; across the table two stern interviewers in dark suits, a middle-aged man and a woman, look at him over their papers. Same face, 9:16.

Change the scene: two days later, a small cosy home kitchen in the morning; the young man in a plain grey T-shirt, same face, sits glumly at a wooden table with a cup of tea; his phone on the table lights up and vibrates. Window light, 9:16.

Change the scene: five years later, a small warm design studio with big windows over the city, plants, wooden desks, sketches and colour swatches pinned on a board; the young man, now a little older and confident, same face, a RED TIE loosened over a casual shirt, sits at his desk and turns to the camera with a calm smile; in the background the receptionist in the teal blazer with the yellow pencil waves at him. 9:16.
